t: A maze-driving robot that children program with physical command tiles.
steps: Order KUBO through a local partner listed on the official KUBO site.
Open the free curriculum on the KUBO Portal.
Book the free onboarding and teacher training.
Charge the robot and sort the TagTiles.
Run the first puzzle activity with the tiles.
Add the Coding, Math or Music add-on sets later.
Try KUBO Play only after you review its privacy terms. It needs teacher-created classes.
